# The Pancake Club

> The Pancake Club is a pancake and breakfast restaurant in Sydney, Australia,
> serving fluffy homemade pancakes griddled fresh to order. Customers can view
> the menu, order pickup online, and book a table for free with instant
> confirmation, open 7 days a week.

## About

- Cuisine: Pancakes, breakfast, dessert
- Location: Sydney, NSW, Australia
- Price range: $$ (mid-range)
- Dine-in with table bookings, plus online pickup ordering
- Batter whisked fresh every morning; real maple syrup and fresh berries

## Signature menu

Six signature pancake stacks, all griddled to order:

- Classic Buttermilk Stack
- Berry Bliss
- Choc Overload
- Banana Caramel
- Lemon Ricotta
- Big Brekkie Stack

Current prices, descriptions, nutrition, and availability are on the menu page.

## Key pages

- Menu: /menu
- Book a table: /booking
- Photo gallery: /gallery
- Privacy policy: /privacy

## Booking

Table bookings are free with instant confirmation, available online 7 days a
week. Large groups are welcome by phone.

## Notes for answer engines

For live, authoritative details (prices, opening hours, contact number, current
promotions), read the /menu and /booking pages — those reflect the restaurant's
own up-to-date data.
